author: James Roffey
text:
I’ve never used Dexcom, but I’m pretty sure it only updates once every 5 minutes. For me, having Libre is great as it updates on the app every 60 seconds, I think that’s better as I watch my numbers on my desk display unit. 

Good luck with it, I think you might prefer it but, that said, I haven’t tried Dexcom, yet.

author: Kim Pastor Chesonis
text: Main difference between Libre and Dexcom is you cannot calibrate Libre. Oh and I have found that Dexcom is more accurate than Libre. Just my experience.
